Photo 1: Front view of the same printer with closed scanner lid. HP logo visible. Text 'LaserJet Enterprise MFP E62665' is faintly visible below the logo. Watermark present.

Photo 2: Collage of five images. Top left: same as photo 0. Top right: same as photo 1. Bottom left: close-up of color touchscreen display. Bottom middle: open toner compartment showing four color toner cartridges (black, cyan, magenta, yellow). Bottom right: side view showing network, USB, and wireless ports. Text overlays describe features: LARGE COLOR TOUCHSCREEN DISPLAY, EASY ACCESS TONER & MAINTENANCE, NETWORK, USB & WIRELESS CONNECTIVITY. Bottom banner lists: UP TO 65 PPM, MONTHLY DUTY CYCLE UP TO 300,000 PAGES, ENTERPRISE SECURITY & RELIABLE PERFORMANCE, BUILT FOR HIGH VOLUME & HEAVY DUTY USE.
